# Only dirty or index/log/recent-changes pages are regenerated

Pages are only regenerated if they are dirty, except for index.md, log.md, and recent-changes.md, which are always regenerated.

To minimize unnecessary file writes and improve efficiency during wiki emission.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/wiki/emitter.py` — `knowledge_compiler.wiki.emitter.WikiEmitter.emit`
